content: Good afternoon, this is Lisa from Evergreen Realty. How can I assist you with your property concerns today?
Hi Lisa, I recently invested in a condo through your agency, but I've been worried about some maintenance issues that keep popping up. Is this normal?
I reassure you that occasional maintenance is part of property ownership, but we take these matters seriously. You can trust me to help you address these issues promptly.
That's comforting to hear, but I'm concerned it might affect the value of my investment.
Don't worry, I'm here to ensure your investment remains solid. We have a dedicated team handling maintenance and property value protection, and I'll personally monitor your case.
Thanks, Lisa. What should I do if another problem arises?
You can reach out to me anytime. I'll guide you through the process and make sure your concerns are resolved quickly. You can trust me to keep your best interests at heart.
